title: Finding the rogue cron filling /tmp: a 12 GB session leak
lede: The alert came in at 3:14 on a Tuesday. /tmp on a small VPS had crossed 12 GB of orphaned PHP session files. Here is how we found the cron behind it.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: cron schedule sheet, log printout, paper tags, brass CRON plate, steel ruler, pencil, red wax seal.
